name: Seeded Gaussian noise for latents and images
plain: Adds seeded Gaussian noise scaled by the tensor's own spread, so the same strength means the same relative change on any model's latent. Its image node is named ImageAddNoise, the same as a core node, so ComfyUI keeps core's node and drops this one.
math: z' = z + ε·strength·std(z), ε seeded per batch item.

providers.author: ttulttul
providers.note: Not installed here. Read at commit 86d3d20; the README calls the pack a set of perturbation tools, not a sampler.
